title: SK Hynix plans $29 billion Nasdaq ADR listing — SKHY begins trading July 10
summary: SK Hynix lists on Nasdaq today (July 10) under ticker SKHY via ADRs priced at ~₩242,500 (~$158/ADR), raising $29.4B — the largest-ever U.S. IPO by a foreign company, surpassing Alibaba and Saudi Aramco. Proceeds fund Yongin Semiconductor Cluster fab and EUV lithography equipment. SK Hynix holds 58% HBM market share in Q1 2026.
why: SKHY今日挂牌纳斯达克，史上最大外国公司在美IPO，HBM龙头正式在美上市为AI半导体板块注入流动性，对持仓SK海力士（HBM供应商）及NVDA（HBM买家）均有估值示范效应

title: China consumer price growth weakens in June while producer inflation rises to near 4-year high
summary: China CPI rose 1.0% y/y in June — missing consensus of 1.1% and slowing from May's 1.2%. PPI jumped 4.1% y/y, strongest since July 2022, driven by elevated energy costs from US-Iran conflict. Core CPI edged to 1.0% (from 1.1%). Food prices fell 1.6% y/y.
why: CPI低于预期显示内需偏弱，对消费类持仓（海底捞、蜜雪冰城、携程等）构成压力；PPI强劲反映成本端通胀，可能延缓降息；整体利空港A股风险偏好

title: 港股7月10日收盘：恒指跌0.7%至24030点，恒生科技持平，半导体人形机器人板块活跃
summary: 恒生指数收报24030.18点，跌0.7%；恒生科技指数收4731.56点，微涨0.01%。盘面上半导体、人形机器人板块持续活跃，科技龙头分化。今日SK Hynix（SKHY）在美纳斯达克挂牌，港股科技情绪受跨市提振。
why: 今日港股整体偏弱，关注腾讯、阿里、美团等持仓个股相对恒指的分化；科技板块implied vol动向值得观察

title: Hang Seng Index edges down as region gets US tech lift
summary: HSI edged down July 9 as oil topped $74 on US-Iran tensions, lifting Treasury yields. Notable movers: SMIC +4.2%, Xiaomi +1.7%, Lenovo +3.9%, MiniMax +2.0%, Iluvatar CoreX +4.6%, Knowledge Atlas +14.5%. AI firm Zhipu AI launched HK share sale seeking to raise up to HK$4B.
why: 半导体与AI股继续引领港股，小米持仓单日涨1.7%，Zhipu AI港股IPO显示港股AI估值热情延续；原油上涨对通胀预期与债券收益率构成扰动

title: Fed minutes expose deep divide over interest-rate outlook
summary: June FOMC minutes show 9 of 19 officials project at least one rate hike in 2026, while others see rates on hold or lower. New Fed Chair Warsh dropped traditional forward guidance in favor of pure data-dependence. Fed funds target range holds at 3.50–3.75%. CPI was 4.2% y/y as of May 2026.
why: 美联储内部分歧超预期，Warsh风格转变为纯数据驱动，利率路径不确定性上升；对市场隐含波动率有支撑，Sell Put策略需注意利率重定价风险带来的市场波动

title: 早新闻｜A股重大调整，今日施行！
summary: A股交易新规7月6日正式施行：①盘后固定价格交易从科创板扩展至全部A股及ETF；②基金收盘阶段从连续竞价改为收盘集合竞价；③主板风险警示股票涨跌幅限制由5%调整为10%。
why: 主板风险警示股涨跌幅扩至10%是结构性制度改变，提升定价效率；ETF盘后交易范围扩大有利于机构流动性管理；A股制度完善信号

title: BABA Stock Jumps As Legal Cloud Lifts And AI Bets Grow
summary: Alibaba and AUS Merchant Services agreed to a $600M non-prosecution settlement with the U.S. DOJ over historic illegal pharmaceutical sales, including $325M in penalties and forfeitures. A U.S. District Judge also granted Alibaba a temporary reprieve from a Pentagon-linked law. BABA rose to $108.46 on July 8, up ~11% from $95.98 at June 30.
why: DOJ和解解除重大法律不确定性，股价单日涨超11%；阿里持仓者/Sell Put者需重新评估行权价——BABA已从$96快速拉升至$108，近期期权行权风险下降但需更新行权价位

title: 市值回落近两万亿 腾讯怎么了
summary: 腾讯股价自2025年10月高点677港元已回撤逾31%，年内跌幅超21%，约2万亿港元市值蒸发。Q1 2026营收1965亿元同比增9%，净利润581亿元增21%，基本面稳健。市场主要担忧AI开发进展及消费端Agent投资回报可见度不足，导致估值倍数收缩。高盛维持Buy，目标价700港元。
why: 腾讯基本面未恶化但AI估值溢价消退，持续回购（近期累计超7亿港元）提供底部支撑；Sell Put持仓者可在当前低位考虑行权价保护，注意implied vol水平

title: 腾讯控股(00700.HK)于7月6日回购46.50万股，耗资2.05亿港元
summary: 腾讯控股7月6日通过港交所回购46.50万股，耗资2.05亿港元。结合7月3日回购114.9万股（5.01亿港元），本周合计回购超7亿港元，为股价提供支撑。
why: 腾讯在市值回落约2万亿港元期间持续加速回购，显示管理层认为当前估值被低估；对Sell Put持仓者，持续buyback可减缓下行风险，下行保护边际改善

title: Tesla (NASDAQ:TSLA) Shares Up 3.2% on Analyst Upgrade
summary: Tesla Q2 2026 deliveries: 480K+ vehicles (record), production 450K+, energy storage 13.5 GWh. RBC Capital raised price target to $500. TSLA traded at $404.77 (+3.39%) on July 9. Optimus Gen 3 supply chain target: 1,000 units/week by September 2026.
why: Q2交付480K创历史新高，Optimus量产节点临近，RBC目标价$500仍有上行空间；对特斯拉期权持仓者，正面催化剂可能压低implied vol，Sell Call/Covered Call或有机会

title: What Is Going on with NVIDIA Stock on Wednesday?
summary: NVIDIA denied reports its Kyber NVL144 AI platform would be delayed to 2028, saying it remains on schedule — stock bounced >1% on the denial. Separately, reports emerged China may allow top AI firms to buy limited H200 chips (NVDA +3.6%). Reuters reported DeepSeek is developing its own AI chip to reduce Nvidia dependency. NVDA was trading near $197.
why: Kyber否认移除短期产品路线图不确定性；中国H200传言若落实将重开被封锁的中国大市场；DeepSeek自研芯片是中期威胁；NVDA期权在重大催化剂来临前隐含波动率仍高

title: HSBC Just Issued Wall Street's Boldest Call on Intel Stock
summary: HSBC doubled Intel price target from $100 to $200 (July 2), maintaining Buy. Analyst Frank Lee now includes Intel Foundry in SOTP valuation. Key drivers: server CPU shipments +25% in 2026, +30% in 2027; data center & AI revenue est. $24.1B (2026), $33B (2027). Average consensus target ~$101.
why: HSBC目标价远超市场共识$101，若foundry逻辑落地将触发大幅估值重估；英特尔期权波动性相对较高，此升级若引发跟进效应，INTC持仓或有显著上行空间

title: Palantir Just Hit $300 Billion. The Numbers Say That's Only the Start.
summary: Palantir's market cap crossed $300B (July 8). Q1 2026 revenue: $1.632B (+85% YoY), highest in company history. Full-year 2026 guidance: $7.65–7.66B revenue (~71% growth). DA Davidson upgraded PLTR to Buy, raising PT to $175 from $165. PLTR closed at $129.30 on July 2.
why: PLTR市值破3000亿，Q1营收增速85%为公司上市以来最高，DA Davidson升级至Buy；但估值已极高，Sell Put行权价需设在相对保守位置，注意高beta标的在市场回调中的波动
